dogecoin.text: Everyone I talk to "is up" on dogecoin no matter how low it goes. Be honest with your friends when you lose money, the denial will do more damage than losses on a meme ever will.

@dogecoin is a shitcoin because there's no reason to hold it. Flush it before you lose everything. Take that value (money or understanding) and invest in utility, communities, and tools. You want long term assets in your portfolio, not short term laughs. https://t.co/R1mHHuKeJR
